title: Accu Check insight pump doesn't connect to AAPS app
symptom: After completing all setup steps, the Accu Check Insight pump does not connect to AAPS. The pump is not connecting to another device. The issue persists after restarting from scratch with another laptop and trying two different pumps.
fix: Rebooting the phone (turning it off and on a couple of times) allowed the pump to pair with AAPS.
evidence_quote: I did a reset with my phone. Turned it of and on for a couple of times and able to pair the pump with AAPS.
